hook: Your view here looks like Avatar's floating mountains.
title: These Avatar Mountains Are Real
description:
These sandstone pillars are in Zhangjiajie, China, and they inspired the floating mountains in the film Avatar. One pillar was even renamed Avatar Hallelujah Mountain. Nothing floats, but the clouds make it look like it does.

#Shorts #China #PlacesThatShouldntExist
comment_prompt: Would you visit? Yes or no
